verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents machine-to-machine Client Credentials flow for authenticating applications/agents instead of users, RBAC/scopes for narrow permissions, and explicit agent-identity messaging ('Give each agent a unique digital identity for more secure access to APIs, apps, and MCP servers') plus fine-grained AI-agent authorization docs. This covers least-privilege, per-agent machine identity well, but the pack lacks explicit documentation of instant/immediate revocation mechanics for agent credentials specifically (only general log-streaming/monitoring is shown). Missing for 10: explicit instant-revocation workflow for agent/M2M credentials, independent hands-on verification of agent identity issuance and revocation in practice.
